description: IND-01 PM-1: production methods for existing factory buildings (Victoria 3-style structure; project data, not Paradox content). A method sets the input mix per unit of output; output per worker stays in RECIPES x technology efficiency effects. Owners use the cheapest unlocked method at their market prices (hysteresis); a player may fix a method. Values are project design values unless a source is given; the coke iron mix is ECON-CAL-03 (CG-25, Kane 1845 / Staffordshire 1828-37).

textile_mill.note: Water and hand power; no coal.
Grid electricity represented by its coal until GOODS-1 adds electricity.

ironworks.note: Charcoal smelting and forging; timber per unit is a design value.
Converter steel: less fuel per ton (design value).

arms_works.note: Interchangeable parts: more machinery, less waste (design value).
